newsitem.title: UK: ICI in bid for Unilever's Unichema - report.
newsitem.headline: ICI in bid for Unilever's Unichema - report.

text.p: ICI Plc has joined the bidders for Unilever 's chemicals division by tabling an estimated one billion sterling bid for Unichema, one of four operations up for sale at Unilever, The Sunday Telegraph said.

Unilever said in February it planned to sell most of its speciality chemicals businesses, putting up for sale four divisions -- National Starch & Chemical Co, Quest International, Unichema International and Crosfield.
The report said initial bids for the four were due to be submitted this week to Lazard Brothers, which will then draw up a shortlist of bidders who will go into a second round.
It said Unilever had forced all bidders to sign strict confidentiality agreements.
An ICI spokesman said the company had no comment to make on the report.
